evidence_policy.note: Evidence and test paths identify development records. The capability manifest ships; docs/mcp/evidence and _studio/tests do not. Package inventory checks validate references without claiming those files ship or establishing release/client qualification.

release_gate.note: The ordinary test validates inventory integrity only. Pending entries do not establish implementation, parity or client compatibility. Release also requires independent runtime, client and recovery qualification.

boundaries.native_ai_execution: Built-in provider generation, tests, live model discovery and Router evaluation are not callable through provider-free MCP. External equivalents are tracked separately; REST /prompt and Studio chat remain separately billed.
boundaries.interactive_owner_or_session_flow: Initial owner bootstrap, private workspace activation, current-session account flows, fresh owner approval/secret reveal, and owner takeover recovery require an interactive owner/session. An MCP credential is not a session or proof of fresh human approval.
boundaries.public_interface: Published visitor data/tool discovery, generated public MCP, visitor Action manifests and demo-only responses retain their separately documented interface. Existing REST visitor-tool routes still require their REST credential. They are not aliases for private draft management capabilities; public responses and exports exclude authoring memory and private diagnostics.
boundaries.existing_product_restriction: The shipped Studio explicitly refuses this operation; preserving that refusal is the parity contract, not a missing capability.

unshipped.evidence: Collection routes are commented out in _studio/api/router.php; endpoint source alone is not a shipped route.
